notes: Positive: explicit requests to write a development plan / implementation plan / tasks.md from an approved spec; PR sequencing; spike identification; AC-to-task traceability; lite-plan when spec is partial. Negative: code implementation, PRD authoring, test-plan authoring, architecture design, code review, threat model, ADR authoring, cross-feature roadmap. Edge: lite plan variant, regulated-environment plan, plan where PRD is missing.
